steps.heading: Start with the outline
steps.caption: Protect your table. Follow the preprinted lines. Keep the background white. Use thin coats; rinse and blot between colors.

steps.heading: An even orange base
steps.caption: Paint the pumpkin orange in two thin coats, drying between coats. Leave the stem and carved face white; keep both teeth orange.

steps.heading: Olive-green stem
steps.caption: Mix green with brown for olive. Paint the stem, following its bend. Keep the outer printed contour clear.

steps.heading: The carved smile
steps.caption: Mix black with a little brown. Fill the eyes, nose and mouth carefully around the orange teeth. Let these dark shapes dry.

steps.heading: Shape the grooves
steps.caption: Mix orange with brown for russet shadows. Pull narrow curved strokes beside the printed grooves and around the pumpkin base.

steps.heading: Golden rib highlights
steps.caption: Mix orange with yellow and a little white. Pull lighter strokes down the raised ribs, leaving the shaded grooves visible.

steps.heading: Stem & finishing edges
steps.caption: Mix yellow with brown and a little white for stem highlights. Pull strokes along the bend; tidy carved edges with black and brown.

steps.heading: Dry & clean up
steps.caption: Lay the canvas flat until fully dry. Wash brushes, wipe the palette and close the paint pots.
